Length of GeneralPurposePdu with category SD The length attribute for GeneralPurposePdu s with category = SD shall be set to at most EthernetCommunicationConnector . maximumTransmissionUnit minus the sum of the length of the following headers: • IP Header (for IpV4: 20 bytes, for IpV6: 40 bytes) • IpV4 and IpV6 : any optional additional headers, e.g. for IPSec • Udp Header (8 bytes) • Socket Adaptor PDU Header (8 bytes)
